purpose: Locate rose SFT failure with one matched expert-prefix takeover; do not train or count assisted outcomes as autonomy.
reference: Published VLABench fine-tuned reference without project SFT updates
sampler: Seed 42; consume 28 JAX noise chunks for the 140 expert prefix controls, then sample the policy normally.
required_checks: Actual saved expert actions execute through the same adapter and official controller
Reference and SFT initial states, prefix controls and takeover measurements/RGB match
Both models execute at least one post-prefix policy chunk
Expert-assisted videos and results never enter autonomous success counts

interpretation.both_succeed: Consistent with sensitivity to earlier rollout drift; does not identify its unique cause.
interpretation.only_reference_succeeds: Evidence of SFT suffix regression even after a matched near-demonstration prefix.
interpretation.reference_fails: The takeover comparison does not establish a feasible reference suffix from this prefix.

scope: Diagnostic only; do not resume PPO or choose formal test outcomes from it.
